brief: Bug: jarvis/v2/stores.py _Store._append writes a JSONL line under the module _lock but _read_lines takes no lock, so a reader that lands mid-write sees an unterminated last line and raises StoreError ('path:N: Unterminated string ...'). It shows in tests/v2/chat_relay_check.py and, in the product, in a transcript load, chat_read or the runner's read_log. Make a read never fail on a line still being written, without hiding corruption: only the LAST line, and only when the file does not end in a newline, may be treated as a write in progress and left out (also when the write is cut in the middle of a multi-byte character). A malformed interior line, a malformed newline-terminated last line (LF or CRLF), any other invalid UTF-8 and non-object JSON still raise StoreError with the same 'path:N:' messages; an unterminated last line that parses is still returned. Records are separated by the newline only: any other Unicode character inside a JSON string, including line and paragraph separators, is record data, never a break; a CRLF-rewritten file still reads.
